summary: Completed comprehensive testing of frontend-only course selling website. All 15+ features tested successfully with excellent UI/UX implementation, dark theme with purple/blue accents, and perfect navigation flow.
passed_tests: Home page loads with hero section, featured courses, categories, and CTA
Navbar displays logo, navigation links (Home, Courses, Dashboard), Login and Get Started buttons
Mobile menu toggle works and shows navigation links properly
Courses page displays all 9 courses in a grid layout
Category filters work correctly (Web Development: 3, Data Science: 3, Design: 3, All: 9)
Level filters work correctly (Beginner: 3, Intermediate: 3, Advanced: 3, All: 9)
Search functionality filters courses by title, instructor, and description
CourseDetail page shows complete course info, price, curriculum, Buy Now button
Buy Now button logs to console and shows toast notification perfectly
Dashboard shows purchased courses with accurate progress bars (78%, 45%)
Dashboard shows completion stats (3 enrolled, 1 completed, 86 hours, 74% avg progress)
Dashboard shows certificates section with 1 earned certificate and download button
Login page displays form with email, password fields, remember me, social auth
Register page displays form with name, email, password fields and password strength indicator
Navigation works seamlessly between all pages via navbar, buttons, and links
Toast notifications work for login, register, and purchase actions
Dark theme with purple/blue gradient accents implemented perfectly
